title: Coolie: Reba Monica John Is 'Upset And Disappointed' With Her Role In Rajinikanth Starrer | Tamil Cinema News - News18
text: Rajinikanth starrer Coolie is one of the most popular films. Recently, Reba Monica John, who was also in the prominent role in the film, has candidly shared her disappointment regarding her limited role. In an interaction with her fans, the actress revealed that while she was grateful for the opportunity to share screen space with the superstar but her experience was bittersweet as she felt her potential was not fully explored. According to a report by The Times of India, Reba Monica John has expressed her disappointment for the limited role in the film. The portal mentions that during a chat with her fans, the Bigil actress said, “I am really upset and disappointed. I know I could have offered so much more, but sometimes things don’t go your way. Still, I am happy that I got the chance to work with Thalaivar Rajinikanth." She was seen as Revathi Rajasekar, the younger sibling of Shruti Haasan’s character Preethi in the film. About Coolie: The film, which was released on August 14, marks Rajinikanth’s 171st film as a lead actor. With the superstar in the titular role, the film boasts an ensemble cast featuring Nagarjuna Akkineni, Soubin Shahir, Upendra, Shruti Haasan, Sathyaraj, Aamir Khan, Rachita Ram and Reba Monica John. When and Where To Watch Coolie? Directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj, Coolie is currently streaming on OTT starting today. The film is available to watch in Telugu, Malayalam and Kannada dubs and can be accessed not only in India but also in over 240 countries and territories across the globe. The OTT giant confirmed the news on social media by sharing a poster with the streaming details. Alongside it, they wrote, “Get ready to vibe with the saga of Deva, Simon, and Dahaa #CoolieOnPrime, Sep 11." Coolie: Plot Colie is set against the gritty backdrop of smuggling operations at the Visakhapatnam harbour, where a powerful crime syndicate run by Simon Xavier and his associate Dayalan dominates the underworld with gold and organ trafficking. Rajinikanth steps into the role of Devaraj “Deva," a principled boarding house owner who carries a mysterious past. When Deva’s close friend dies under suspicious circumstances, he is drawn into an investigation that peels back the layers of the syndicate’s sinister empire, which even includes a modified electric chair used for executions. As the truth begins to surface, Deva’s journey takes an emotional turn when he uncovers a shocking family connection that changes everything. Coolie: Box Office Success Reportedly, Lokesh Kanagaraj’s Coolie was mounted on a massive budget of Rs 350 crore and has collected Rs 514.65 crore worldwide. It has grossed Rs 336.2 crore in India and earned Rs 228.47 crore net at the domestic box office, as per Sacnilk. Coolie hit the theatres on August 14, 2025 and witnessed a box office clash with Ayan Mukerji’s War 2, starring Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in the lead roles.
